info.name: ChangeCars API (staging - Wowcar)
info.description:
Staging API: https://changecarapi.wowcar.co.th

Import into Postman. Set customer/dealer/admin credentials in collection variables, then run the matching login request. Sample record IDs come from the local database export; replace if needed. Requests that create, update or delete records affect staging data.
